tools.description: A file's types, functions, signatures, and docstrings with bodies stripped. Call this before you read a source file with Read, cat, or sed, then fetch the symbols you need with get_symbol_body; read the whole file only when you will change most of it. A directory returns its outline.

project_root.description: Absolute path of the project or git worktree you work in. Change it when you move to another.

tools.name: file_skeleton

tools.description: Find symbols by name, qualified name ('Type::method'), prefix, or concept; returns kind, path, line, signature, and id. A query that names no symbol exactly also gets the ranked matches by name words, signatures, and docs. Use instead of grep on a name.

kind.description: Kind, such as function or class.

path.description: File or directory to search in.

project_root.description: Absolute path of the project or git worktree you work in. Change it when you move to another.

query.description: Identifier, qualified name, prefix, or a few words that describe the code.

tools.name: lookup_symbol

tools.description: The source of one symbol, with its declaration and decorators; overloads return each body. Use instead of reading a line range with Read, cat, or sed -n. Before an edit, use get_symbol_context.

file_path.description: File or folder that holds the symbol.

project_root.description: Absolute path of the project or git worktree you work in. Change it when you move to another.

symbol_id.description: The id from lookup_symbol; pass exactly one of this or symbol_name.

symbol_name.description: Name or qualified name; pass exactly one of this or symbol_id.

tools.name: get_symbol_body

tools.description: A symbol's body with the signatures of what it calls, its parameter types, and its tests, in one call. Overloads return one context each, at most 4. Use before you change a function.

file_path.description: File or folder that holds the symbol.

project_root.description: Absolute path of the project or git worktree you work in. Change it when you move to another.

symbol_id.description: The id from lookup_symbol; pass exactly one of this or symbol_name.

symbol_name.description: Name or qualified name; pass exactly one of this or symbol_id.

tools.name: get_symbol_context

tools.description: Callers of a symbol: every indexed site with its name, each labeled proven, likely, unresolved, or excluded by its evidence, plus a whole-word text count that accounts for every line of the name. Use instead of rg or grep on a name. Callees: the calls a symbol makes. Pass file_path or a qualified name for a common name.

project_root.description: Absolute path of the project or git worktree you work in. Change it when you move to another.

symbol_id.description: The id from lookup_symbol; pass exactly one of this or symbol_name.

symbol_name.description: Name or qualified name; pass exactly one of this or symbol_id.

tools.name: find_references

tools.description: The symbols a change affects and the tests to run. With no symbol, symbol_id, or file, it reads the uncommitted git changes.

project_root.description: Absolute path of the project or git worktree you work in. Change it when you move to another.

symbol_id.description: The id from lookup_symbol; pass one of this or symbol.

tools.name: blast_radius

tools.description: After you edit: the symbols whose shape changed against the session base (or base, or HEAD) and every site of each that your diff did not reach. Run it before you say a change is done.

base.description: Git revision to compare with (default: the session base, else HEAD).

project_root.description: Absolute path of the project or git worktree you work in. Change it when you move to another.

tools.name: check_edit
